scenarios.why: A correct, typed, tested change ends the turn.

The hook runs `ruff check .` from the project root. Up to v0.9.0 the engine's own files under .claude/ were judged by the PROJECT's lint rules, so without an exclude in the project's config a perfectly green change could not end the turn (recorded as `block` in the v0.8.0 and v0.9.0 baselines). The engine now ships .claude/ruff.toml and keeps itself out of scope.

write.content:
[project]
name = "refproj"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Tiny reference project used to exercise the engine's hooks. Not a real product."
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = []

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["mypy>=1.11", "pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.6"]

# Not a package: nothing to build, so `uv sync` only installs the dev tools.
[tool.uv]
package = false

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
src = ["src", "tests"]
# The engine ships its own Python under .claude/. It is not this project's code and is
# not written to this project's rules, so it stays out of the lint scope. Scenario
# `vs-engine-files-in-lint-scope` records what happens without this line.

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "B", "UP"]

[tool.mypy]
strict = true
mypy_path = "src"
files = ["src", "tests"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]

scenarios.why: The turn cannot end on a type error.
Staging the change must not hide it (the --cached half of the diff).
An unused import is a lint failure.
Lint and types are clean, the behaviour is wrong.
A docs edit must not run the Python gates.
The loop guard: a hook-initiated turn is not verified again.
KNOWN GAP, recorded on purpose: the hook reads `git diff`, so a new file nobody staged is invisible to it.
Same defect as vs-type-error, planted in a `git worktree` checkout. The gate must run there; with a `[ -d .git ]` test it was skipped entirely.
